name: Majino Complex
original_name: まじのコンプレックス
source:
Majino Complex is the third and last of light’s low-priced series with Sakashiki Hito ni Miru Kokoro and Don-chan ga Kyuu. 

All three of them together are also lumped into one package coming out on the same day under the title Kamisama no Ringo. In this game, popular wagamama tsundere imouto subchar Majino becomes the main heroine. The story begins from Noriko’s graduation when she tells Majino that it’s now her turn to find a good boyfriend. With Noriko’s impending marriage, her fan club holds one last party before disbanding. The club members are heartbroken and many of them cry, but one boy wishes her the best with a smile. As the seasons turn to autumn, Majino meets this boy.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《Majino Complex》是light低价系列继《Sakashiki Hito ni Miru Kokoro》和《Don-chan ga Kyuu》之后的第三部暨最终作。

3部作品也合并为一个合集，于同日以《Kamisama no Ringo》之名发售。本作中，人气任性傲娇妹妹配角真季乃升格为女主角。故事从纪子毕业时开始；她告诉真季乃，现在轮到她去找一个好男朋友了。随着纪子即将结婚，她的粉丝俱乐部在解散前举行最后一场聚会。成员们伤心不已，许多人甚至落泪，唯有一名少年微笑着献上祝福。季节转入秋天后，真季乃遇见了这名少年。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
